description_en: Disassociates a domain name from Global Accelerator (GA) instances
description_zh: 调用DeleteDomainAcceleratorRelation接口删除加速域名的配置
kebab_example: aliyun ga delete-domain-accelerator-relation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-ids ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --domain www.example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDomainAcceleratorRelation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the GA instance to be disassociated. You can specify up to 50 IDs.

If you leave this parameter empty, all GA instances associated with the specified domain name are disassociated
parameters.help_zh:
待解除关联的全球加速实例ID。最多支持输入50个全球加速ID。

为空时默认删除指定加速域名下所有关联关系
parameters.name: accelerator_ids

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name to be disassociated
parameters.help_zh: 指定待解除关联的加速域名
parameters.name: domain
